name: Meshimase Ouji-sama
source:
One kingdom approaches hereditary crisis. Royal family decides to hold a competition with the best candidate to be adopted as a prince.
Main character is a teacher of poor aristocracy candidate Rufus. But under the mask of duties  hidden love starts to flourish.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-september-2002-masaru.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
某个王国正面临王位继承危机。王室决定举行一场比赛，将最优秀的候选人收养为王子。
主人公是贫穷贵族候选人Rufus的老师。然而在职责的掩饰之下，一份爱情悄然萌芽。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-september-2002-masaru.html]vndbreview[/url]]
